title: A non-technician made lead through the Public API is accepted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Have a valid Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation for staff, and a request tool (Postman or any tool that sends requests with that key).
  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by nobody (no lead).
custom_steps:
1. Send a Public API work order update with the API key that makes staff member A the lead of work order 1.
  2. Open work order 1 in the app.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The update is accepted, as today.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 shows staff member A as its lead.
  • In the Lead Technician dropdown staff member A is listed last, grayed out, with the check mark.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11883 (Story 5, Public API - technician value on staff)

  • S3-N3: “Technician narrows only what is offered. A non-technician who is made lead or added to a labor line another way (an outside tool through the Public API, or a screen opened before the change) is accepted as today, and so is job time they record (S3-E3).”
  • S3-R7: “A work order's current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 still shows as the lead on the work order and in Board View and Tech View. In the Lead Technician dropdown they are listed last, grayed out, with the check mark, and cannot be picked. Picking someone else saves at once, as today, and the former lead then leaves the dropdown.”
  • Key Decisions: “Technician also decides only who is offered, not who can be assigned or record time: assignment and clocking are checked as today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
